findings.claim: No test exercises components_lacking_reloc_metadata; the three new tests call module_reloc_risk directly. Reverting this call site to any(!has_reloc_metadata) passes all of them, so the shim-taint fix itself is unguarded despite the PR's potency claim.

Predicate changed but any_component_lacks_reloc_metadata's doc still says it is true when any core module lacks linking/reloc.* and uses the same probe as resolve_address_plan so the warning 'cannot disagree'; both are now false, and auto-mode's info text inherits the change.

findings.quoted_line: /// True only when the module BOTH defines its own memory AND lacks
findings.claim: module_memory_type returns Some for an IMPORTED memory too, so the predicate is 'defines or imports a memory', not 'defines its own'. The test helper only builds defined memories, so the import arm (e.g. a reloc-less adapter importing memory) is untested.
